summary: Sega AM3 and Sega-AM4's Isle of Man TT-inspired motorcycle racer, first released on Model 2 arcade hardware and later expanded on Saturn and Windows.

entries.title: Manx TT Super Bike
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC conversion for main route; arcade cabinet for physical authenticity

emulation.notes: Use a compatible Windows setup for the primary; use original arcade hardware or Model 2 preservation for cabinet-fidelity comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows higher-resolution/3dfx route for graphics; physical leaning cabinet only in arcade

primary.why: The Model 2 arcade version has the unique body-weight bike cabinet, but the Windows conversion is sourced as being based on the Saturn game with higher resolution than arcade, improved shadows, perspective correction, increased draw distance, 3dfx support, newer voices, enhanced gameplay modes, and 8-player multiplayer like the arcade. It is the best fidelity-and-completeness route if the physical cabinet is not the deciding factor.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version on compatible PC hardware or a preservation setup with 3dfx support where possible; use the arcade cabinet separately if physical bike controls are the priority.

entries.remaster_caveats: Windows is a conversion based on the Saturn release, not a modern remaster; original cabinet controls remain arcade-only.
